docs.title: 📚 All 13 Curriculum Tracks
docs.text: Track 1 • Aligned with Chapter 1 Introduction to Datasets          Taxonomy of structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data. Core quality dimensions: accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, and relevance.                 ⚡ 7 Guided Parts • PPTX / PDF Slides • Schema Translator & Splitter        Explore Track 1 → Track 2 • Aligned with Chapter 2 Fundamentals of Data Collection          Sampling theory and mathematical error limits. Simple random, stratified, and cluster sampling. Power analysis and real-world population coverage.                 ⚡ 9 Guided Parts • PPTX / PDF Slides • Sampling Techniques Visualizer        Explore Track 2 → Track 3 • Aligned with Chapter 3 Ethics and Privacy in Data Work          Regulatory governance under GDPR, HIPAA, and CCPA. Mathematical anonymity models: $k$-anonymity, $l$-diversity, $t$-closeness, and differential privacy ($\epsilon, \delta$).                 ⚡ 11 Guided Parts • PPTX / PDF Slides • PII Scrubber & De-ID Risk        Explore Track 3 → Track 4 • Aligned with Chapter 4 Data Annotation & Agreement          Human-in-the-loop annotation workflows, bounding boxes, segmentation, and NER. Inter-Annotator Agreement (IAA): Cohen's $\kappa$, Fleiss' $\kappa$, and Krippendorff's $\alpha$.                 ⚡ 10 Guided Parts • PPTX / PDF Slides • Text/Image Lab & IAA Calculator        Explore Track 4 → Track 5 • Aligned with Chapter 5 Data Cleaning & Preprocessing          Missing data mechanisms (MCAR, MAR, MNAR) and imputation. Statistical outlier detection (Z-scores, Tukey IQR). Feature scaling and class imbalance (SMOTE).                 ⚡ 12 Guided Parts • PPTX / PDF Slides • Cleaning Workbench & Scaling Lab        Explore Track 5 → Track 6 • Aligned with Chapter 6 Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)          Univariate, bivariate, and multivariate inspection. Covariance structures, Pearson/Spearman correlation matrices, confounder detection, and Simpson's Paradox.                 ⚡ 12 Guided Parts • PPTX / PDF Slides • Automated EDA Dashboard        Explore Track 6 → Track 7 • Aligned with Chapter 7 Dataset Bias and Fairness          Representational, historical, and measurement bias. Mathematical fairness criteria: Disparate Impact Ratio, Equalized Odds, and Demographic Parity frontiers.                 ⚡ 10 Guided Parts • PPTX / PDF Slides • Representation Visualizer & Fairness Meter        Explore Track 7 → Track 8 • Aligned with Chapter 8 Documentation & Version Control          Standardized metadata schemas and Gebru et al. Datasheets for Datasets. Dataset version control using Git LFS and Data Version Control (DVC).                 ⚡ 10 Guided Parts • PPTX / PDF Slides • Datasheets Builder & Version Timeline        Explore Track 8 → Track 9 • Aligned with Chapter 9 Advanced Data Collection          Ethical web crawling, Robots.txt parsing, sliding-window API rate limits, backoff strategies, and real-time IoT sensor telemetry streams.                 ⚡ 10 Guided Parts • PPTX / PDF Slides • Telemetry Simulator & Robots Auditor        Explore Track 9 → Track 10 • Aligned with Chapter 10 Synthetic Data Generation          Data augmentation heuristics, text paraphrasing, Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), Diffusion models, and privacy-preserving synthetic record generation.                 ⚡ 10 Guided Parts • PPTX / PDF Slides • Text & Image Augmentation Labs        Explore Track 10 → Track 11 • Aligned with Chapter 11 Advanced Annotation Techniques          Active learning query heuristics (uncertainty sampling, query-by-committee), weak supervision (Snorkel labeling functions), and label aggregation under noisy annotators.                 ⚡ 10 Guided Parts • PPTX / PDF Slides • Active Learning & Snorkel Simulator        Explore Track 11 → Track 12 • Aligned with Chapter 12 Scalable Data Management          The CAP theorem in distributed storage. Columnar formats (Apache Parquet, Arrow, ORC) vs. row stores. Data lakes, partitioning, and cloud object stores (S3).                 ⚡ 10 Guided Parts • PPTX / PDF Slides • Storage Chooser & Parquet Lab        Explore Track 12 → Track 13 • Synthesis & Governance Reproducibility & Open Science          The FAIR data principles (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable). Open science licensing (Creative Commons, Open Data Commons), and persistent data identifiers (DOIs).                 ⚡ 10 Guided Parts • PPTX / PDF Slides • Open Science Checklist & License Lab        Explore Capstone Track 13 →
